1.name: Kingston Flemings
1.comment: Flemings (back tightness) will not return to Friday's game against the Bulls.

1.name: Mouhamed Gueye
1.comment: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

1.name: Keshon Gilbert
1.comment: Gilbert (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Bulls.

1.name: Asa Newell
1.comment: Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Chicago.

1.name: Henri Veesaar
1.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

2.name: Paul George
2.comment: George (illness) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Toronto, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

3.name: Dejounte Murray
3.comment: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

3.name: Bryce McGowens
3.comment: McGowens (elbow) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

3.name: Yves Missi
3.comment: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

3.name: Trey Murphy III
3.comment: Murphy (knee) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

3.name: Trendon Watford
3.comment: Watford (ankle) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

4.name: Jalen Smith
4.comment: Smith (hand) exited Friday's 125-117 win over the Hawks in overtime and did not return, finishing with 15 points (6-15 FG, 1-6 3Pt, 2-2 FT), 12 rebounds, three assists and three steals across 32 minutes.

4.name: Dailyn Swain
4.comment: Swain (back) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

4.name: Tobe Awaka
4.comment: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

4.name: Caleb Wilson
4.comment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

5.name: Evan Mobley
5.comment: Mobley (toe) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

5.name: Sam Merrill
5.comment: Merrill (elbow) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.

5.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
5.comment: Tomlin is set to miss several weeks with a lower back stress reaction, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

6.name: Max Christie
6.comment: Christie is questionable for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to a sprained left ankle.

6.name: Morez Johnson Jr.
6.comment: Johnson (left shin contusion) is listed as probable for Saturday against Cleveland.

6.name: Dereck Lively II
6.comment: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Thursday's game in Minnesota.

6.name: Tarik Biberovic
6.comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Thursday's game against Minnesota.

6.name: Sergio de Larrea
6.comment: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game at Minnesota.

7.name: Julian Strawther
7.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

8.name: Ugonna Onyenso
8.comment: Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.

8.name: Isaiah Joe
8.comment: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Wizards.

8.name: Jalen Duren
8.comment: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

9.name: Stephen Curry
9.comment: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

9.name: Brandon Williams
9.comment: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

9.name: Kristaps Porzingis
9.comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

9.name: Moses Moody
9.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

9.name: Jimmy Butler III
9.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

10.name: Marcus Smart
10.comment: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

10.name: Clint Capela
10.comment: Head coach Ime Udoka stated Monday that Capela (ankle) could be cleared to return either Nov. 15 in Washington or Nov. 16 in Miami, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

10.name: Steven Adams
10.comment: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could return as soon as Sunday's game at Washington, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

11.name: Aaron Nesmith
11.comment: Nesmith exited to the locker room in the final seconds of Friday's 106-104 win over the Knicks due to an apparent hand/wrist injury, Tony East of Forbes.com reports. He posted 18 points (7-10 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 2-2 FT), seven rebounds and one assist in 33 minutes.

11.name: Tyrese Haliburton
11.comment: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

11.name: Johnny Furphy
11.comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

11.name: Ben Sheppard
11.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

12.name: Brandon Ingram
12.comment: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

12.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
12.comment: Niederhauser (foot) is out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

12.name: Bradley Beal
12.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

12.name: Jordan Miller
12.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

13.name: Quentin Grimes
13.comment: Grimes (finger) said he expects to return to action Sunday against the Suns, according to Ricardo Sandoval of Lakers on SI.

13.name: Austin Reaves
13.comment: Reaves (heel) won't undergo imaging and is considered day-to-day ahead of Sunday's game against the Suns, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.

13.name: Luka Doncic
13.comment: Head coach JJ Redick said Friday that Doncic (ankle) is "fine," per Law Murray of The Athletic.

13.name: Collin Sexton
13.comment: Sexton did not return to Wednesday's 123-112 win over the Bucks and required stitches to close a cut on his forehead, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.

14.name: Klay Thompson
14.comment: Thompson (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Cavaliers.

14.name: Pelle Larsson
14.comment: Larsson (illness) is out for Friday's game against Cleveland.

16.name: Anthony Edwards
16.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

16.name: Donte DiVincenzo
16.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

17.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
17.comment: Brown (illness) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against Memphis.

17.name: Nolan Traore
17.comment: Traore (calf) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against Memphis.

19.name: Jonathan Isaac
19.comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Sacramento.

19.name: Paolo Banchero
19.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

19.name: Noah Penda
19.comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

19.name: Izaiyah Nelson
19.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

20.name: LeBron James
20.comment: James (back) is out for Thursday's game against Toronto.

20.name: Dominick Barlow
20.comment: Barlow (back) participated in Thursday's shootaround but doesn't have a timeline to return to game action, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

20.name: Adem Bona
20.comment: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

20.name: Ariel Hukporti
20.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

21.name: Drew Timme
21.comment: The Suns claimed Timme off waivers Monday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.

21.name: Mark Williams
21.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

22.name: Chris Youngblood
22.comment: Youngblood (foot) is out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

22.name: Vit Krejci
22.comment: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

22.name: Ja Morant
22.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

22.name: Shaedon Sharpe
22.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

23.name: Precious Achiuwa
23.comment: Achiuwa (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Trail Blazers.

23.name: Maxime Raynaud
23.comment: Raynaud (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

23.name: Ben Simmons
23.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

24.name: Tobias Harris
24.comment: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Chicago, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.

24.name: Jayden Quaintance
24.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

25.name: Ajay Mitchell
25.comment: Mitchell (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

25.name: Thomas Sorber
25.comment: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

25.name: Jaylin Williams
25.comment: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland and remains out indefinitely.

25.name: Cason Wallace
25.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

25.name: Chet Holmgren
25.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

25.name: Jalen Williams
25.comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

26.name: Jaxson Hayes
26.comment: Hayes won't return to Friday's game against the Rockets due to a left knee issue.

26.name: Trey Alexander
26.comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

26.name: Lauri Markkanen
26.comment: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

26.name: Jusuf Nurkic
26.comment: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

26.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
26.comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

27.name: Bub Carrington
27.comment: Carrington (chest) has been ruled out for the remainder of Thursday's game against the Pistons.

27.name: Tristan Vukcevic
27.comment: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Detroit.

27.name: Reece Beekman
27.comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

27.name: Justin Champagnie
27.comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

27.name: Jamir Watkins
27.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

28.name: Kevin McCullar Jr.
28.comment: McCullar signed a two-way contract with the Raptors on Thursday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

28.name: Trayce Jackson-Davis
28.comment: Jackson-Davis is out for Thursday's game against the 76ers due to an illness.

28.name: Scottie Barnes
28.comment: Barnes (groin) is out for Thursday's game against Philadelphia.

28.name: Kawhi Leonard
28.comment: Head coach Darko Rajakovic said Wednesday that Leonard (knee) is doing individual on-court work and is progressing well, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

28.name: Nate Bittle
28.comment: Bittle (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against Memphis.

29.name: Quinten Post
29.comment: Post (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against New Orleans.

29.name: Zach Edey
29.comment: Edey won't play in Friday's game against the Pelicans due to left ankle injury management.

29.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
29.comment: Pippen (back) remains out for Wednesday's game against Denver, Michael Wallace of the Grizzlies' official site reports.

29.name: Richie Saunders
29.comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

30.name: Brandon Miller
30.comment: Miller (groin) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Phoenix.

30.name: Kon Knueppel
30.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

30.name: Dennis Schroder
30.comment: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
